verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a stateless document-conversion CLI and library, not a platform that stores or manages automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. The evidence shows only user-side practices: putting plain-text sources under external version control, or running Pandoc inside GitHub Actions. Those are host-platform or workaround capabilities, not Pandoc's own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
